blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Since the success of Quezon City, Metro Manila’s largest local government unit, relies on strong barangays, its officials should keep strengthening their communities through “honest, responsive, and compassionate leadership.” House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” stressed that message in his address on Monday evening during the 31st Quezon City Barangay Day Celebration at the Grand Ballroom of Novotel Manila in Quezon City. Dy, who once served as barangay chair in Cauayan, Isabela, highlighted the unique place that barangay officials have in government, being the closest and first authorities people approach whenever they have problems in their community — whatever the time […]...
